about_the_game:
We are excited and proud to announce that for the first time ever in the world of Virtual Reality, players will be able to engage with each other in actual, real-life combat! They can either play against the computer’s avatars or against real players in real-time.

Another great first for Meta Quest Users:  Bare hands (no controllers needed for bare-hands play) are a huge plus - and again, ours is a history-making app by allowing real-life play with either bare hands or using weapons. Controllers are needed for weapons usage, but you have to experience it to believe it!  You will not believe how great it is to spar with someone anywhere in the world!  Great app for single-player and multiplayer use.  No room or chance here for boredom! 

Note : To enjoy the hand tracking feature you must set your Meta Quest Link App as Open XR Runtime from Settings > General > Set Meta Quest Link As OpenXR Runtime.

Anyone interested in practicing combative self-defense will rise to the challenges in the program, as they enjoy the many chances to improve their techniques and fitness levels. Those who simply enjoy the thrill of competitive fighting sports will find this app challenging as well as fun! You can challenge yourself to improve your score, and a neat by-product will be to get your body moving and exercising! And, don’t miss our amazing new bow-arrows, guns, knives and shuriken shooting gallery!  Need to relax? You can visit our Meditation and Yoga areas, too.

In addition to this,  SETVR XL Unleashed has an amazing educational experience in a Japanese Village with History Generals that will undoubtedly enrich your appreciation and knowledge in Martial Arts.

 So, get ready, and get SET VR XL Unleashed!



NOTE : HAND TRACKING WORKS WITH META DEVICES (META QUEST 2, META QUEST 2 PRO, META QUEST 3, META QUEST 3S) WITH META QUEST LINK (AIR LINK OR CABLE) AND META QUEST LINK IS SET TO - ACTIVE OPEN XR RUNTIME -.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 3S, Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest Pro, Meta Quest 2
  • Additional Notes: Requires Oculus Link (USB-C) or Air Link
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti / RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 3S, Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest Pro, Meta Quest 2
  • Additional Notes: Requires Oculus Link (USB-C) or Air Link
